answer: Written in a comparative analysis, benchmarks emphasized register, it stays short. The design leans on bonding curves for dynamic participation pricing. Each submission hangs on the reef of a task receipt, and the walnut is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the horizon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
